notes.title: Cats in Time is now a part of Escape Simulator world!
notes.content:
We are both delighted and overwhelmed to share the amazing news that we have officially sold more than [b]1 million copies of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599880/Cats_in_Time/?utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=ES_level]Escape Simulator[/url][/b]. We never anticipated our game to reach this amount of success and we are incredibly thankful for each and every one of you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/2431ca4ea9eece6d1678f092eff96e7d59f4b480.gif[/img]
To celebrate this very special occasion, we are glad to announce that as of today, you will be able to play through [b]a new official room[/b]! This new room pays tribute to our cutest game - [b]Cats In Time![/b]

[h2]Can you make it in time?[/h2]
[previewyoutube=dze1DmQFDg0;full][/previewyoutube]
In the new Cats In Time room, you will need to figure out how to repair Professor Tim Edger's time machine. However, this task won't be easy and you might just run into some strange issues while trying to fix the device. The clock's ticking! Will you be able to finish your task within thirty minutes? 😼

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790/Escape_Simulator/?utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=ES_level
To celebrate this milestone, both Cats In Time and Escape Simulator are 20% off on Steam. Don't miss out on these discounts and make sure to tell all of your friends! 😉

Pine Team <3

notes.title: Small patch #2
notes.content:
Meow everyone!
Cats in Time currently hold [b]100% positive ratings[/b] on Steam!! Thank you all for playing and taking your time to write a review; it means so much to us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/99d14282523b49d9cde3dd73075595333ebd84b5.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, we worked on multiple fixes and again fixed [b]ALL[/b] the reported bugs. Thank you all for reporting. 
You can see the complete changelog list here:
[list]
[*] Added better volume controls
[*] Added postcard zoom-in function
[*] We cut a few trees in New York
[*] Fixed missing sounds in Atlantis pack
[*] Fixed broken audio in Level 17
[*] Fixed the flag in Level 11
[*] Fixed the card bug in Level 23
[*] Increased the hook area in Level 10
[*] Fixed the broken hint in Level 28
[*] Fixed the kids mode in Level 2,12,15 and 22
[*] Fixed the small zoom area in Level 6
[*] "Secret puzzle" is now open when playing in Kids Mode
[*] Fixed the key bug in Level 22
[*] Fixed a few translations in Japanese (Thank you [i]hydro-guppy[JP][/i]), Chinese, Portuguese, and German. 
[/list]
Have fun exploring!
Pine team

notes.title: Cats in Time is coming out on August 26th!
notes.content:
Hello explorers! 😸
We are happy to announce that [b]Cats in Time[/b] is coming to Steam on [b]August 26th[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/574943fdd8f61368d862aef93e9733364b5c032c.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The time machine is set and ready for a lift-off 
[*] All [b]290 kitties[/b] are already hidden and waiting for you to save them! 
[*] All [b]7 locations[/b] are ready, including the new Atlantis location with 4 never seen before levels
[*] New "[b]Easy Mode[/b]" is available
[*] New [b]music, hats, and achievements[/b] are turned on
[/list]
Don't forget to [b]wishlist [/b]the game so you get the notification once it goes live! 😉

See you in [b]2 weeks[/b]! 😻
Pine team
